title: iterate
description: server -> client PCG iterate, sent every k iterations (CLAUDE.md §10.3). theta in K. cert_k = Lemma 2 bound in K on the error of every cell at iterate k; null = no certificate for this board (the M-matrix check of §8.4 failed), so no guaranteed band may be drawn.

f16_field.description: base64 of little-endian float16, row-major [layer, y, x]; decoded length must be 2 * prod(shape) bytes (checked by validate.py / contracts.js)

shape.description: [4, n, n]; shape[1] == shape[2] is checked by validate.py / contracts.js
